title: Can Persona-Prompted LLMs Emulate Subgroup Values? An Empirical Analysis of Generalisability and Fairness in Cultural Alignment
reasoning: The research specifically evaluates how LLMs emulate 'Religious Values', which it identifies as the most divisive value category. It benchmarks models across subgroups defined by faith (e.g., Buddhist, Muslim, Christian, Hindu) and analyzes model responses to ethically sensitive topics like abortion, euthanasia, and homosexuality.
